title: The ideals ℓ^{n+1}O_E are nested
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every $n\ge0$, $\ell^{n+2}\mathcal O_E\subseteq\ell^{n+1}\mathcal O_E$.
